description: This file defines classes and methods related to company configuration and messaging in an Odoo module, including a res.company extension and a wizard for setting up company info.

classes.name: res_company
classes.description: Extension of the res.company model adding an overdue message field with a default message.

classes.name: company_setup
classes.description: Wizard class for inserting and managing company information, including methods for retrieving messages, onchange behavior, creation, and cancellation actions.

methods.name: get_message
methods.description: Retrieves the overdue message and phone number for a company to display in the wizard.

methods.name: onchange_company_id
methods.description: Updates partner and overdue message fields when the company is changed in the wizard.

methods.name: action_create
methods.description: Saves the wizard data to the res.company model and opens a new configuration window.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the wizard and closes the window.
